propositions: Merge-abort recovery logic is duplicated across sync.reconverge and push_recovery, with drift in the quarantine mover (sync lacks the tracked-file fence that push_recovery implements)
The two movers have diverged in safety checks: push_recovery._quarantine_untracked_paths validates tracked files before moving via git status --porcelain, but sync._quarantine_untracked does not

Consolidate the merge-abort toolkit (parsers, quarantine movers, local-change restorer) into a neutral merge_recovery.py module that accepts git as a callable parameter to support both module-level and late-bound git seams
Maintain thin delegating adapters in sync.py and push_recovery.py to preserve existing call signatures and monkeypatch points for backwards compatibility
A construct-uniqueness guard at AST function scope ensures exactly one quarantine mover exists in the codebase outside merge_recovery.py, flagged by mandatory # quarantine-move-ok: <reason> markers
